environment.databases: isolated synthetic test databases; existing user documents not used

engine.mode: verified diagnostic development kit; not optimized production evidence

checks.note: Final targeted run includes three boundary tests added after the full run; counts overlap.

checks.ai: one mock AI transport case; no real model calls

verified: arbitrary nonadjacent and reversed version pairs
paragraph-level account attribution through intermediate saves
unknown legacy authors and honest single-user local identity
format-only changes and reference ID renumbering
native table-cell locations and page shifts after large insertions
empty paragraph formatting, duplicate ambiguity and image resource hashes
reader access, cross-document rejection and permission revocation
transaction failure preserves version and author consistency
immutable original bytes and comparison without API writes
open editor's unsaved bytes, revision and edit lease preserved
save, download, reopen and restore regressions
native document highlights and unclipped modal at multiple zoom levels
known_limits: Authors identify the account saving a change, not the creator of an externally uploaded file.
Legacy versions have no author backfill; local mode cannot distinguish people.
Nested tables and generic objects have no inferred highlight coordinates.
Bounded history and document sizes are documented; unsupported cases are surfaced.
